# Canonical Release CSV Naming Policy

Read `.github/instructions/release-csv-names.instructions.md` in the repository
root being reviewed, not relative to the skill directory, with a read-only file
tool. It is the canonical policy for
scope, unknown-field handling, evidence, and advisory feedback. This adapter
intentionally does not duplicate its rules.

The local evaluations copy that exact in-PR instruction into each isolated
workspace and require the reviewer to read it. No cross-repository clone,
pinned revision, second policy snapshot, or shell command is needed.

If the canonical file is unavailable, report that limitation rather than
inventing review rules or using a stale mirror.
